name: circuit-is-one-workout
why: Ashley's ruling A, 8 Oct 2026: a circuit off the round timer is ONE workout made of blocks, logged with propose_circuit_log, built only from the rounds, times and effort SHE stated. Not five separate cardio logs, not 'Intervals', not log_workout (sets and reps of lifts). She gives the rounds, the length, the blocks and the effort in one message, so the card can come at once.
messages: just did 5 rounds on the timer, 3 minutes each: skipping rope, press-ups, sit-ups, the bike, then rope again. really hard
